requirements.quote: At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.
Experience building and shipping backend services that run in production in the cloud.
Operates AI-native: you build with modern AI coding tools as your default way of working, not occasionally, and use them to move fast without lowering the quality bar.
Learns quickly and takes on unfamiliar parts of the stack with little ramp-up.
Finds work instead of waiting for it: you recognize problems, propose solutions, and follow them through.
Has taken something from idea to production, at work or on your own time.
Communicates clearly with teammates and is comfortable working directly with customers.
Builds for the customer’s outcome, with a high bar for quality and no over-engineering.
Comfortable working across languages. Our stack is mainly Kotlin and Python, with TypeScript on the front end.
Comfortable working across languages. Our stack is mainly Kotlin and Python, with TypeScript on the front end.
Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, or adapting models, through work, research, or substantial projects.
Experience building evaluation or scoring for models or agents.
Experience with audio, speech-to-text, or text-to-speech.
Experience as a founder or early startup engineer, or taking a system from zero to one.
Typically 2+ years of engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
